docs.summary: Interface for implementing a canvas renderer backend. Implement this interface to provide rendering support for different graphics APIs (OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, etc.).

members.name: CreateTexture
members.signature: public object CreateTexture(uint width, uint height)

docs.summary: Creates a new texture with the specified dimensions.

params.width: The width of the texture in pixels.
params.height: The height of the texture in pixels.

docs.summary: Gets the dimensions of a texture.
docs.returns: The size of the texture in pixels.

members.name: SetTextureData
members.signature: public void SetTextureData(object texture, IntRect bounds, byte[] data)

docs.summary: Updates a region of a texture with new pixel data.

params.data: The pixel data in RGBA format (4 bytes per pixel).

members.name: RenderCalls
members.signature: public void RenderCalls(Canvas canvas, IReadOnlyList<DrawCall> drawCalls)

docs.summary: Renders the accumulated draw calls to the screen or render target.

params.canvas: The canvas containing vertices and indices.
params.drawCalls: The list of draw calls to render.

docs.summary: Whether this backend implements backdrop blur (capturing and blurring the framebuffer behind a shape). When false, backdrop-blur draw calls degrade to flat tinted fills.
